newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Petron Jan-Mar net slightly up.
newsitem.headline: Petron Jan-Mar net slightly up.

text.p: The Philippine's largest oil refiner Petron Corp said on Wednesday it posted a net income of 1.049 billion pesos in the first three months of the year compared with 1.026 billion the same period last year.
It said revenues in the first quarter rose by 10 percent to 14.2 billion pesos from the year-ago level of 12.9 billion pesos.
Petron attributed its gains for the first quarter to higher non-operating income complemented by lower operating expenses.
The oil refiner said it sold 13.9 million barrels of petroleum products for the first three months this year.
Petron said it has the biggest market share at 42.1 percent. One of three local oil refiners, Petron operates a 165,000 barrels per day (bpd) refinery in Bataan, south of Manila.
